lines.text: The fathers brought the tabernacle in with Joshua, it remained until David's time, and Hezekiah built the house for God.
Stephen says the Most High does not dwell in houses made by human hands, and quotes the prophet about heaven being His throne.
Stephen tells the council they always resist the Holy Spirit and are betrayers and murderers of the Righteous One.
Stephen sees Moses standing at the right hand of God, and the council drags him out of the city and stones him.
Stephen asks the Lord Jesus to receive his spirit and falls asleep, and Saul begins to destroy the church.
